# beast-civilization — llms-full.txt (v0.5.0 Compact Context Bundle)

## Summary
`beast-civilization v0.5.0` ("The Matrix Singularity") is a zero-dependency polyglot bare-metal Agent Civilization, Post-Quantum Colony, Trinity Autonomous Forge (OS Microkernels + 4-Layer Chimera LLMs + Bare-Metal A-Life Worlds), & Evolutionary Compute Substrate unifying `nagisanzenin/{INIT-Agent,nonhuman,engram,effortmining,nagi,strictlybetter,crucible,math-first}`, `temm1e-labs/{temm1e,temrust}`, `tsotchke/{eshkol,moonlab,quantum_geometric_tensor,quantum_rng,rosette-wire,libirrep,PINN,spin_based_neural_network,tensorcore}`, `0thernes/{autophage,cellular-engine-omega,cellulogonic-mecha,noetic-organism-omega,planaria,alife-singularity-omega-package}`, and MIT/ICLR 2026 Cache-to-Cache / Swarm Telepathy across **Zig `0.17.1`**, **Rust `1.94.1` (8 crates)**, **CRuby `3.4.9`/Prism/YARV**, **C11 (`11 / 11` live native DLLs)**, **QEMU `11.1.0` Ring-0 booted AI microkernels**, **Win32 Kernel Job Objects**, **NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti `sm_12.0` 3-Kernel PTX**, and **50 Pure Lean 4 `v4.35.0` Theorems**.

## Build & Verify
Run `.\build.ps1` (6 layers: Zig `beast_metal.dll` + 6 upstream Tsotchke DLLs [`qrng`, `pinn`, `libirrep`, `moonlab_qgt`, `moonlab_mlkem`, `sbnn`] + freestanding `x86_64` Multiboot2 & live-booted `i386` Multiboot1 ELFs + 8-crate Rust workspace + 25-gate/25-mutant suite + Win32 Kernel Job Objects + 4-layer GQA→Chimera C2C LLM + Trinity Forge + 3-kernel RTX 5070 Ti PTX + 10-gen CRuby/YARV breeder + 50 Pure Lean 4 proofs).
